title: Finding the Art Room on a Small Campus
instructions: 这是为中文成人学习者编写的原创模拟听力材料（非官方雅思测试，不涉及真实分数）。请先听录音（或阅读文字稿），注意 there is / there are、地点介词、现在进行时和祈使句。然后完成 8 道听力题。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。建议先不看文字稿听两遍，再核对答案。
transcript: Mia: Excuse me, Tom. Where is the art room? Tom: It is next to the library. Go straight and turn left at the café. Mia: Is there a map near the gate? Tom: Yes, there is. Look, two students are drawing on it. Mia: Are there any chairs in the art room? Tom: No, there aren't. But there are six tables. Mia: What is the teacher doing now? Tom: She is opening the window. Please don't run in the hall. Mia: Thank you. Oh, is that your bag? Tom: No, it isn't. My bag is under the desk. Mia: Sorry! Tom: That's OK. The art room is very quiet now.

grammar.title: there is / there are；地点介词；现在进行时；祈使句入门
grammar.explanation: 先看意思：there is 表示“有一个（单数）”，there are 表示“有多个（复数）”。地点介词说明位置，如 next to（在旁边）、under（在下面）、near（在附近）、at（在某个点）。现在进行时表示“正在做”，结构是 am/is/are + 动词-ing，例如 is opening、are drawing。祈使句表示命令或请求，直接用动词开头，如 Go straight、Turn left、Please don't run。注意：否定 there isn't / there aren't 表示“没有”。
grammar.example: It is next to the library. Go straight and turn left at the café. She is opening the window.

questions.prompt: ___ a small shop near the school.
questions.explanation: a small shop 是单数，用 There is。
questions.evidence: There is a small shop near the school.

questions.explanation: two bikes 是复数，用 There are。
questions.evidence: There are two bikes under the tree.
The cat is under the table.

questions.explanation: now 表示正在发生，boys 是复数，用 are playing。
questions.evidence: Look! The boys are playing football now.

questions.explanation: she 是单数，现在进行时用 is reading。
questions.evidence: She is reading a book now.

questions.explanation: 祈使句用动词原形开头，Turn left 表示“左转”。
否定祈使句用 don't + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: Please don't run in the classroom.

questions.explanation: milk 不可数，视为单数，疑问句用 Is there。
questions.evidence: Is there any milk in the fridge?
